title: Quadratic majorant for a Hessian score
statement:
Let $\iota$ be a set, let $c,z\colon\iota\to\mathbb R$, and let $v>0$. For any $i,j\in\iota$ and any $a\in\mathbb R$ with $|a|\le1$, one has
\[\left|\left(\frac{(z_i-c_i)(z_j-c_j)}{v^2}-\frac{\delta_{ij}}{v}\right)a\right|\le\frac{(z_i-c_i)^2+(z_j-c_j)^2}{2v^2}+\frac1v,\]
where $\delta_{ij}=1$ if $i=j$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ is a nonzero nonnegative real, hence positive.
replaced: Let $I$ be a set, $c,z\in\mathbb R^I$, $v>0$, $i,j\in I$, and $a\in\mathbb R$ with $|a|\le1$. Then $|(((z_i-c_i)(z_j-c_j)/v^2-\delta_{ij}/v)a)|\le((z_i-c_i)^2+(z_j-c_j)^2)/(2v^2)+1/v$, where $\delta_{ij}=1$ if $i=j$ and zero otherwise.
